lines.t: Looks upon the words of this Book:
If anyone adds to these words,
I will add to them the punishments
Away from the words in the Book
Of this prophecy, I will take away
Their share in The Tree of Life
And The Holy City, as it is written.
For as I am so shall I be,
As I have spoken so I speak,
And that which was written by
My prophets of old remains standing,
